subject: Conditional retain bridge & subprocessor census
messages:
From: Sophie Hart <sophie.hart@clearviewlabs.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Erickson <tom.erickson@clearviewlabs.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial questions on retention bridge and subprocessors

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the quick onboarding session earlier. A few follow-ups from Legal and our infra team as we go through the DPA: 

1) For EU-hosted workloads, can Redwood confirm the exact backup purge cadence for snapshots that contain EU customer data? Our security team expects a documented window and an emergency rollback path.
2) We need a list of current subprocessors involved in backups/archival and whether any are located outside the EU. A simple CSV will do — name, role, country, and whether they hold immutable snapshots.
3) If we need to request a temporary retention hold (e.g., legal investigation), what is the fastest route and SLA for pausing purge jobs and creating an immutable hold?

Attached is a redline from our counsel and a simple spreadsheet template you can fill. Can you loop in someone on ops and legal at Redwood so we can align?

Best,
Sophie Hart
Head of Security Operations
Clearview Labs

Attachments: redline_request_v1.pdf (summary), retention-template.csv (format)

From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Hart <sophie.hart@clearviewlabs.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 18:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial questions on retention bridge and subprocessors

Sophie —

Thanks for the notes and the template. Looping in Kimberly (Legal) and Karthik (Infra/Privacy) to provide the detailed census and the operational playbook. High level answers up front:

- Backup purge cadence (EU region): daily incremental snapshots retained for 14 days; weekly snapshots retained for 90 days by default. Immutable snapshots are only used for escrow/forensic requests and are kept per-customer policy.
- Subprocessor census: we'll provide a CSV export by EOD Tuesday with geo columns and whether they handle immutable artifacts.
- Emergency temporary hold: we have a 4-hour acknowledgement SLA for legal holds (ticket raised to infra-runbooks), and a target 24-hour window to suspend purge jobs and create an immutable snapshot; full verification can take up to 72 hours depending on storage tier and replication.

We'll also propose a short "retention bridge" playbook for customers who need ephemeral extended windows (7–30 days) versus long-term amendments.

Olga
Senior Privacy Counsel
Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial questions on retention bridge and subprocessors

Hi Sophie / team —

Thanks for the redline and the ask. I've reviewed the DPA excerpt and we can accept most of the wording with clarifications around temporary holds and export requirements. A few notes:

- We can offer a "retention bridge" clause that allows Clearview to request a temporary retain for up to 30 days without a formal DPA amendment, with a documented justification and an engineering ticket. Anything longer requires an amendment.
- The emergency hold SLA (ack + suspend) is consistent with our standard enterprise SLAs; however, if your legal counsel requires a guaranteed immutable state within 8 hours we should discuss a Dedicated capacity addon or escrow handling.
- We will provide a detailed subprocessor CSV (attached) and flag non-EU subprocessors; for cross-border transfers we separate backup replication and application-layer logs.

Next steps: Olga / Karthik to confirm the ops steps; Laura from Product will follow up on Marketplace/Cloud obligations if you’re consuming via AWS Marketplace.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redlined_dpa_v3.pdf (changes inline)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, olga_petrov@redwood.ai, Sophie Hart <sophie.hart@clearviewlabs.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 09:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial questions on retention bridge and subprocessors

Sophie —

Attaching the subprocessor census you requested (CSV) and a short ops playbook below for the temporary-retain workflow. TL;DR: we can pause purge jobs at the region level and snapshot the affected dataset. Steps:

1) Ticket (infra-runbooks tag) created by customer or Redwood AE — include tenant ID, dataset id, and justification.
2) Infra acknowledges within 4 hours and stages a readonly immutable snapshot on warm storage.
3) Purge pipelines targeting that tenant are paused; weekly and daily GC jobs are skipped for the tenant token.
4) We verify replication consistency and provide MD5 checksums within 24–72 hours.

Limitations: snapshots in cold-archive (Glacier-equivalent) require retrieval that can add 12–48 hours; immutable state guarantee is weaker for archived shards. If Clearview needs guaranteed short-window immutability for archived objects, we recommend provisioning Dedicated capacity with a hot-retention tier.

I'll open INF-4292 to track the action items: attach the CSV, vendor flags, and the runbook. Laura — can you confirm if AWS Marketplace customers require additional acknowledgement from marketplace-ops?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Infrastructure Security
Redwood Inference

Attachment: subprocessor_census_060926.csv (stub)

Subject: Re: Initial questions on retention bridge and subprocessors

Thanks — this is exactly what we needed. A couple quick clarifications before I feed back to counsel and infra: 

- Can you add a short bullet in the playbook about the verification artifacts we will receive (checksums, snapshot IDs, timelines) so our forensics folks can rely on those?
- For any non-EU subprocessors listed, can you flag whether they are used only for monitoring/metrics (non-personal) versus backups/archives (personal)?

If those two items are added, Clearview will sign the DPA redline and we can proceed with a short pilot (30-day retention bridge) to validate the process. Please attach the DocuSign link when ready.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

— Sophie
Head of Security Ops, Clearview Labs
